Single pages (the third page: Copy 1 or Copy B, black ink) of the IRS 2025
forms W-2, 1099-INT, 1099-DIV, 1099-R, 1099-NEC and 1098, as published by the
IRS at https://www.irs.gov/forms-instructions (works of the U.S. Government,
not subject to copyright). Used only by `scripts/redaction_leak_corpus.py`,
which fills them with synthetic data; they are never used to tune the
redaction gate.
